name: GitHub Dependabot alerts - migrate CVE labels written by earlier versions

statements.__comment__: DEPRECATED: temporary backward-compatibility migration; remove in v1.0.0. CVEMetadata enriched every :CVE GitHubDependabotAlert. The next statement removes that label, after which CVEMetadata cleanup, which matches :CVE targets, can no longer reach these edges, so delete them first. This statement does not require the :CVE label, so it also catches an edge that a concurrent CVEMetadata sync added between the two statements of an earlier run. Scoped by $org_url to the alerts of the organization that just completed its sync, whose alerts all link to their GitHubSecurityAdvisory. Idempotent: alerts no longer get ENRICHES edges. Each run deletes up to $SCAN_LIMIT_SIZE edges from one scan of the organization, committing every $LIMIT_SIZE; rerunning a LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE statement would walk every already-migrated alert again on each pass, which is quadratic in the organization's alert count.
statements.query: MATCH (:GitHubOrganization {id: $org_url})-[:RESOURCE]->(:GitHubDependabotAlert)<-[r:ENRICHES]-(:CVEMetadata) WITH r LIMIT $SCAN_LIMIT_SIZE CALL (r) { DELETE r } IN TRANSACTIONS OF $LIMIT_SIZE ROWS

statements.__comment__: DEPRECATED: temporary backward-compatibility migration; remove in v1.0.0. Earlier releases put the :CVE ontology label on every GitHubDependabotAlert whose advisory has a CVE, and wrote the CVE _ont_* fields on every alert, with or without the label. The CVE is now the GitHubSecurityAdvisory the alert links to, and nothing updates these any more, so strip them: left stale, :CVE queries count each advisory once per affected repository dependency. Idempotent: once stripped, no GitHubDependabotAlert carries :CVE or _ont_source. Batched like the statement above, for the same reason.
statements.query: MATCH (:GitHubOrganization {id: $org_url})-[:RESOURCE]->(a:GitHubDependabotAlert) WHERE a:CVE OR a._ont_source IS NOT NULL WITH a LIMIT $SCAN_LIMIT_SIZE CALL (a) { REMOVE a:CVE, a._ont_source, a._ont_cve_id, a._ont_description, a._ont_references, a._ont_problem_types, a._ont_vector_string, a._ont_base_score, a._ont_base_severity, a._ont_published_date, a._ont_last_modified_date } IN TRANSACTIONS OF $LIMIT_SIZE ROWS
